name: hzdb_agentic_xr_install
description: Install the Agentic XR MCP proxy into the user's LLM agent (currently only Claude Code is supported) so the LLM gains in-app XR runtime tools (head pose, controllers, image capture, spatial entities) on the next session restart. The Agentic XR proxy itself must be installed first via `hzdb tools install agentic-xr`. Defaults to dry-run (returns the install command text); pass `execute: true` to actually run `claude mcp add ...`.

execute.description: If true, execute the install command (`claude mcp add ...`). If false (default), return the install command text without running it (dry-run).

name.description: Name to register the Agentic XR proxy under in Claude Code. Defaults to 'agentic-xr'.
